title: Practice 3: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: He returned from Friday prayers.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.prompt: Sentences begin with a capital letter.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Разговор начался с ___ (добродушный) подшучиваний, но закончился синяками.
exercises.prompt: The conversation started with friendly banter but ended in bruises.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.prompt: This YouTube channel is popular among Russian audiences.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.prompt: I don't have an employment contract.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Том - это одна из ___ (священный) "икон" Татоэбы. Поэтому он неприкосновенен.
exercises.prompt: Tom is one of Tatoeba's sacred "icons". Therefore, he is untouchable.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.prompt: Oddly, I've been watching a lot of telenovelas this fall.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Она полетела, как стрела из ___ (натянутый) лука.

exercises.q: Том плюхнулся на диван, измученный после ___ (тяжёлый) рабочего дня.
exercises.prompt: Tom flopped down on the couch, exhausted after a hard day's work.

exercises.q: Мимо моего окна пропорхали несколько ___ (запоздалый) снежинок.
exercises.prompt: A few belated snowflakes flitted past my window.
